neet_phy_u20_t05_1.working: Detergent lowers the surface tension T. Since h = 2T cosθ/(rρg), the height of the column decreases.

neet_phy_u20_t05_2.working: By Jurin's law hr is constant, so h2 = 6.0 × 0.25/0.75 = 2.0 cm.

neet_phy_u20_t05_4.working: A: hr = constant is Jurin's law (III). B: contact angle is about 0° (I). C: detergent makes capillary rise decrease (II). D: meniscus correction uses h + r/3 (IV).

neet_phy_u20_t05_5.working: A true. B false, because hot water has lower surface tension and rises less. C true. D true, since h ∝ 1/r. E false, because detergents lower surface tension.
